title: Raw homogeneous product identity before quotient projection
statement: Under the hypotheses of the homogeneous product projection theorem, the product of the two homogeneous sections in the presentation algebra equals the degree n(e+2) image under c of the transported tensor product section.

source.place: Tag 09MS, coherent-equation-ses and the direct-sum exact sequence following it; Tag 0B8S, cohomology-lemma-boundary-derivation-over-cup-product, the quotient action in the first paragraph of its proof.

proof.text: Apply tensorGradedQuotient_multiply to the two transported section inputs. Normalize n+n(e+1)=n(e+2); tensorSectionProduct_comparison identifies the coefficient. Equality transport reduces to reflexivity.

theorem tensorGradedSection_product_raw {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (j : Z ⟶ X)
    [IsClosedImmersion j] (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible] (hI : j.ker ^ 2 = ⊥)
    (n : ℕ) (T : TensorGradedPresentation j L) (D : TensorBoundaryComparisonData j L n)
    (hD : canonicalTensorBoundaryComparisons j L hI n = D)
    (e : ℕ) (f : 𝟙_ Z.Modules ⟶ ((tensorPullback j).obj L).tensorPow n)
    (x : 𝟙_ Z.Modules ⟶ (((tensorPullback j).obj L).tensorPow n).tensorPow (e + 1)) :
    tensorGradedSection T D 0 (tensorPowSection f 1) * tensorGradedSection T D e x =
      (T.c (n * ((e + 1) + 1))).app ⊤
        ((((λ_ (𝟙_ Z.Modules)).inv ≫ (f ⊗ₘ x)) ≫ (D.a (e + 1)).inv).app ⊤
          (1 : Γ(Z, ⊤)))
